subject: tu:game/world/items
value: include/game/item.h's LookoutParam (0x6C) IS the Xbox PDB record `LOOKOUT` (misc.h, Size=0x6C), whose body is exactly { OBJGRP objgrp; s16 next; s16 param; } -- objgrp@0x00 (0x68), next@0x68, param@0x6A. This resolves the header's own standing comment that 'the preceding camera parameters remain opaque': the opaque `u8 data[0x30]` at 0x00 plus `f32 pos[3]` at 0x30 are NOT camera parameters at all, they are rows 0..2 of OBJGRP.worldmat[4][4] followed by its TRANSLATION ROW worldmat[3][0..2]. The full correspondence is: data[0x30]+pos[3]+_pad3C -> OBJGRP.worldmat[4][4] (0x00-0x40, pos == worldmat[3][0..2], _pad3C == worldmat[3][3]); saved_pos[3]+_pad4C -> OBJGRP.attn_pos[4] (0x40); saved_pos2[3]+_pad5C -> OBJGRP.coll_pos[4] (0x50); handle -> OBJGRP.node (struct mbnode*, 0x60); active -> OBJGRP.flags (0x64); next -> next (0x68); id -> param (0x6A). Every one of the four `_padNN[4]` fillers in the current reconstruction is the w-component of a vec4 -- they are not real padding. CONSEQUENCE for consumers: a raw `waypoint + 0x30/0x34/0x38` read is the node's world-matrix translation row and is correctly spelled offsetof(OBJGRP, worldmat[3][k]) on the raw base -- src/game/enemy/critter.c's CritterGetTarget and CritterRotate were converted exactly this way this session (byte-identical). NOT YET APPLIED to item.h itself: rewriting the member list would rename `pos`/`saved_pos`/`saved_pos2`/`handle`/`active` across a header included by 6 TUs, and embedding OBJGRP as a member is forbidden outright by claim.law.embedded-struct-member-whole-tu-cascade (aggregate-typed member in a widely-included header). The size is UNCHANGED at 0x6C either way, independently corroborated twice: items.c declares `LookoutParam lookoutParams[20]` and enemy.c declares `extern u8 sLookoutParams[]` commented 'prowl-node table (stride 0x6C)', so no array-stride consumer moves. A future pass may replace the opaque members with plain f32 arrays-of-scalars (worldmat[4][4]/attn_pos[4]/coll_pos[4]) which is cascade-law-safe, but must gate all 6 including TUs.
